title: Global Bonds Hit By Selloff Ahead of US CPI
description:
Insight with Haslinda Amin, a daily news program featuring in-depth, high-profile interviews and analysis to give viewers the complete picture on the stories that matter. The show features prominent leaders spanning the worlds of business, finance, politics and culture.

Chapters:
00:00:00 - Insight with Haslinda Amin Begins 
00:00:54 - Asian stocks have nowhere to hide from bond selloff
00:03:33 - AMP economist My Bui on bond selloff and inflation concerns
00:11:32 - SK Hynix, Samsung drop on DeepSeek threat to HBM, rate concerns  (11B) State Bank of India Managing Director Ashwini Kumar Tewari on credit demand
00:17:12 - State Bank of India Managing Director Ashwini Kumar Tewari on credit demand
00:23:15 - Trump says US is leading China on AI
00:24:35 -  Xi gears up for first India trip since 2019
00:25:07 - Observer Research Foundation's Antara Ghosal Singh on China-India ties, upcoming BRICS Summit
00:33:36 - NSE downsizes India IPO amid growing valuation concern 
00:37:18 - Emerging: Can Singapore still be a model for growth?
